# Fallout 76 Patch Notes May 6, 2025 (Hotfix)

![Fallout 76 Patch Notes May 6th, 2025 (Hotfix)](/uploads/507_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

The servers are now back online and the Big Bloom event is underway.

Here are the patch notes for this hotfix:

### Hotfix notes – May 6th

Today we released a hotfix with important stability improvements to ensure a smooth start to the Big Bloom seasonal event. The hotfix also fixes the issue that caused players to get stuck in The Catalyst questline and cases where players were disconnected while interacting with the Ammo Storage Crate. Players stuck in The Catalyst quest will need to go to Fort Atlas after downloading the hotfix and start the Trust is Good quest to progress through the questline. We thank you all for your patience as our team investigates and apologize for any inconvenience caused.

Source: bethesda.net
